questions.question: What sign did Isaiah perform against Egypt and Cush?
options: Lay on his side for many days bound with cords
Walked naked and barefoot for three years
Broke a clay jar before the city elders
Buried a linen belt until it rotted away
questions.answer: Walked naked and barefoot for three years

questions.question: What did this sign mean?
options: Egypt would rise up to rule over all of the nations
Judah would make a lasting peace with Egypt
Assyria would lead Egypt and Cush away as captives
A famine would strike the land of the Nile
questions.answer: Assyria would lead Egypt and Cush away as captives

questions.question: The sign warned against trusting in Egypt and Cush for deliverance.
Isaiah walked naked and barefoot for three years as a sign against Egypt and _____.
Behold, this is what has happened to our source of _____, those to whom we fled for help.
